summary: The Iceberg community has been active with discussions on various topics, including the integration with Spark 4.1 and improvements for small file workloads. Proposals are underway for the REST specification and the Iceberg Variant project, while ongoing discussions address metadata management and enhancements to the Iceberg V4 specification.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work and async reader improvements
Vote in progress for consistent wording on table identifier conflict
Proposal for a tracking document for the Iceberg Variant project
Discussion on offloading snapshots from metadata.json
